links.description: Start from Robinhood's node entry point, then follow current Arbitrum Nitro requirements and use the Robinhood chain configuration; expect substantial memory, storage, and parent-chain RPC needs.

Inspect an Arbitrum Foundation-featured Foundry, Next.js, viem, and wagmi Stock Token sample with local, testnet, mainnet, and mainnet-fork paths; it is reference code, not evidence of a deployed production app.
